coordinates: Global X horizontal, Y upward, Z out of plane; pile head local=(0,0,0); local beam X down, local Y global+X. All arrays retain physical magnitude.
scope: One 52m x 1m pile with assumed linear springs, damping and nodal cap load. Not the 947-pile foundation, no coupled tower load, no as-built settlement/capacity prediction.

source.title: Structural Design Challenges of Shanghai Tower
source.authors: Yi Zhu; Dennis Poon; Emmanuel E. Velivasakis; Steve Zuo; Paul Fu
source.evidence: PDF p8: 947 piles, 1m diameter, 52–56m effective length, 6m mat, toe layer9-2-1; Table1 soil depths. p10 mat top -25.4m; 31.4m pile head derived from top+6m thickness, not measured as-built.

assumptions: E=32GPa, rho=2500kg/m3, all stiffnesses/dashpots and 8MN head load are assumptions, not site calibrated.
Head is free to rotate; zero imposed head moment. P/G cap tributary lumped mass participates, no rigid raft stiffness or group interaction.
Elastic beam, small displacement, linear t-z/p-y/toe analogues; no gapping/yielding, groundwater coupling, consolidation, radiation-domain or continuum soil-stress solve.
Dynamic load is prescribed 40s synthetic 0.3MN lateral envelope plus +/-0.4MN vertical modulation, not CFD or tower-reaction transfer.
Depth corrected to source-derived31.4m; previous display model33m differs. Do not move source layers to match the old model.

formulation.mass: rho*A*tributaryLength for translations; rho*I*tributaryLength for rotation; head cap mass P/g added to X,Y
formulation.governing: M u_ddot + C u_dot + K u = F; solve actual OpenSees Newmark(gamma=.5,beta=.25)
formulation.energy: Incremental about gravity equilibrium: W=sum(F_mid dot du); D=sum(v_mid^T C v_mid dt); W=U+T+D
formulation.soilStress: side shear tau_z = soil vertical reaction / (pi*D*tributaryLength); this is interface traction, not continuum soil von Mises

visualization.sign: axialTensionPositive_N: negative compression; sideReactionOnPile_N uses global signs; moment/shear each array stores [head-end,toe-end] internal section values
